title: OLE ANDREAS HALVORSEN'S VIKING GLOBAL JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Viking Global added 327% to Tesla  
(\[TSLA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/)](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/))), opened an $818M  
Mastercard (\[MA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/MA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/MA/))) stake, and sold  
Charles Schwab (\[SCHW\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SCHW/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SCHW/))) and  
Microsoft (\[MSFT\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/MSFT/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/MSFT/))) — what do you  
make of the Q3 13F?  
  
Tickeron AI dug through Ole Andreas Halvorsen's latest Viking Global  
13F and found a few surprises. They multiplied Tesla  
\[TSLA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/)) about 4 times, adding  
327.36% to build an $831M position, and opened a fresh $818M  
Mastercard \[MA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/MA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/MA/)) stake plus a new  
$595M Alphabet \[GOOGL\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/)) line. TSMC  
\[TSM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/)) is now the $1.78B top holding  
after they added 23.22%. On the other side, they sold out of a $982M  
Charles Schwab \[SCHW\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SCHW/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SCHW/)) stake and a  
$544M Microsoft \[MSFT\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/MSFT/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/MSFT/)) position,  
while cutting Visa \[V\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/V/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/V/)) by 32.62% and  
Meta \[META\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/)) by 50.60%.
